skill.name: lark-drive
skill.description: Manage Lark Drive files and folders, including uploads, downloads, metadata, comments, permissions, and comment event subscriptions through lark-cli.
skill.summary: Operate Lark Drive from an AI assistant with guided CLI workflows for files, comments, and permissions.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, placeholder URLs, inline code formatting, and multilingual documentation. The review confirmed risk from an unaudited shared instruction dependency and an upload flow that can grant administrator permissions. The skill is useful for Lark Drive automation but handles file transfer, comments, and permissions, so it needs careful confirmation controls.

remediation.issue: Shared instructions are outside the audited skill boundary.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle or pin the lark-shared instructions with this skill, or include that file in marketplace review.

remediation.issue: Bot uploads can trigger a full_access administrator grant to a user.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation, show the resolved open_id, and log the target before granting administrator access.

remediation.issue: The skill performs write operations and local file transfers.
remediation.suggestion: Keep confirmation gates for uploads, downloads, comments, permission changes, and owner-transfer requests.

- `node.obj_token`:**真实的文档 token**(用于后续操作)

- 局部评论:传 `--selection-with-ellipsis` 或 `--block-id` 时启用;仅支持 `docx`,以及最终解析为 `docx` 的 wiki URL。
- `drive +add-comment` 的 `--content` 需要传 `reply_elements` JSON 数组字符串,例如 `--content '[{"type":"text",
- 如果 wiki 解析后不是 `doc`/`docx`,不要用 `+add-comment`。
- 如果需要更底层地直接调用评论 V2 协议,再走原生 API:先执行 `lark-cli schema drive.file.comments.create_v2`,再执行 `lark-cli dr
- 查询文档评论时,使用 `drive file.comments list`。
- `drive file.comments list` 返回的 `items` 应理解为"评论卡片"列表,每个 `item` 对应用户界面里看到的一张评论卡片,而不是平铺的互动消息列表。
- 服务端语义上,创建第一条评论时会同时创建该卡片里的第一条 reply;因此真正承载正文的是每个 `item.reply_list.replies`,其中第一条 reply 在用户视角下就是这张卡片
- 当用户要统计"评论数"或"评论卡片数"时,统计 `items` 的长度即可;如果是全量统计,则对所有评论分页返回的 `items` 长度累加。
- 当用户要统计"回复数"时,按用户视角应排除每张评论卡片里的首条评论,统计口径是所有 `item.reply_list.replies` 的长度之和减去 `items` 的长度。
- 当用户要统计"总互动数"时,统计所有 `item.reply_list.replies` 的长度之和即可;这个口径包含每张评论卡片里的首条评论。
- 如果某个 `item.has_more=true`,说明该评论卡片下还有更多回复未包含在当前返回中;此时需要继续调用 `drive file.comment.replys list` 拉全后,再做
- 一个文档通常有多个评论,评论按 `create_time`(创建时间)排序。
- **重要**:只有当用户明确提到"最新评论"、"最后评论"、"最早评论"时,才需要根据 `create_time` 进行排序:
- "最新评论" / "最后评论":按 `create_time` 降序排列,取第一条
- "最早评论":按 `create_time` 升序排列,取第一条
- 如果用户只说"第一条评论",直接使用 `drive file.comments list` 返回的第一条即可,不需要额外排序。
- **全文评论不支持回复**:`is_whole=true` 的评论(全文评论)无法添加回复,遇到此类评论应提示用户"全文评论不支持回复"。
- **已解决评论不支持回复**:`is_solved=true` 的评论无法添加回复,遇到此类评论应提示用户"该评论已被解决,无法回复"。
- 使用 `drive file.comments batch_query` 是**已知评论 ID 后**的批量查询,需要传入具体的评论 ID 列表。
- 使用 `drive file.comments list` 用于分页获取评论列表,适合统计评论总数、遍历所有评论,或获取"最新/最后 N 条评论"等场景。

content.user_title: Manage Lark Drive Files and Comments
content.value_statement: Teams need reliable access to Lark Drive files without guessing tokens or API details. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through safe lark-cli workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to extract file, folder, wiki, and document tokens from Lark or Feishu URLs.
Guides file uploads to Lark Drive, including bot-upload permission follow-up steps.
Guides downloads from Lark Drive to local output paths.
Adds full-document or selected-text comments to supported Lark documents.
Lists and counts comment cards, replies, and recent or earliest comments with pagination guidance.
Documents Drive APIs for metadata, copy, permission members, and event subscriptions.
limitations: Requires lark-cli and an authenticated Lark or Feishu account with relevant scopes.
Cannot grant access or write comments when the active identity lacks permission.
Wiki URLs must be resolved before many document operations.
Uploads and downloads interact with local files, so paths must be confirmed.

use_cases.title: Upload Shared Reports
use_cases.description: Move recurring reports into Lark Drive and report the upload and permission result.

use_cases.title: Review Documents With Comments
use_cases.description: Add full-document or selected-text feedback to Lark documents during review cycles.

use_cases.title: Audit Drive Collaboration
use_cases.description: Check metadata, comment state, permission members, and subscription status for shared files.

prompt_templates.title: Upload a File
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload ./report.pdf to folder token fldbc_xxx, then tell me the file token and permission result.

prompt_templates.title: Download a File
prompt_templates.prompt: Download file token boxbc_xxx to ./downloads/report.pdf. Ask before overwriting any local file.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve and Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve this wiki URL, confirm the document type, then add a full-document comment asking for release notes.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Comment Activity
prompt_templates.prompt: List all comments for this document, handle pagination, find the latest unresolved comment, and say whether it can receive a reply.

output_examples.input: Upload ./report.pdf to a Lark Drive folder.
output_examples.output: The file was uploaded to the requested folder. The response includes the file token, upload status, and whether user admin access was granted.

output_examples.input: Add a selected-text comment to a Lark document.
output_examples.output: The comment was added to the matching text. If multiple matches were found, the skill asks for a narrower selection instead of guessing.

output_examples.input: Count all comments and replies in a document.
output_examples.output: The response separates comment cards, visible replies, and total interactions, with pagination handled before sorting or counting.

best_practices: Confirm user intent before uploads, comments, permission changes, or owner-transfer requests.
Resolve wiki URLs to object type and object token before selecting an API.
Use dry-run or schema checks for complex requests before writing data.
anti_patterns: Do not assume a wiki token is the same as a file token.
Do not grant admin access or transfer ownership without confirming the target identity.
Do not sort recent comments from one page when the user asked for an all-time result.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It guides lark-cli operations against Lark or Feishu Drive using configured authentication.

faq.question: Can it upload local files?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide uploads from local paths to Drive folders when permissions allow.

faq.question: Can it change documents?
faq.answer: Yes. Uploads, comments, permissions, and subscriptions can change Drive resources when requested.

faq.question: How are wiki links handled?
faq.answer: The skill resolves wiki links to the real object type and token before using document APIs.

faq.question: Does it store credentials?
faq.answer: No credential storage is shown in reviewed files. It relies on lark-cli authentication.

faq.question: Is it safe for sensitive files?
faq.answer: Use it carefully. Verify destination folders, user identity, and permission changes before write operations.
